column1: # G7 phases 3-4: provenance -- WHY the value at a path holds
# record as a JSON object: `value` and the ordered `conjuncts`
# (each {canon, role, site}), or `code` and `note` when the answer
# is a refusal. A finding's `message` is excluded, as every other
# verb's goldens exclude it: prose is per-port, codes are not.
# A CONTRIBUTION is a value the author WROTE that met something at
# this path. Values the engine mints on the way (a kind lifted while
# a disjunct trials its members, a fold's intermediate) are not
# contributions; nor are the members INSIDE one written value, which
# meet at the same path as that value resolves. A conjunct is the
# exception in the other direction: its terms are separately written
# and each has its own site, so it expands.
# Roles: literal, spread (a template applied to this key), ref (the
# reference itself, whose canon names its target) and pref.
# Contributions are in SOURCE order -- file, row, column -- not meet
# order, which is the fixpoint's business and a parity risk.
# Every expectation was obtained by the parity probe (AGENTS.md):
# both engines were run over this corpus and diffed field by field
